webhook.title: Webhooks
webhook.blankDescription: Webhooks POST the conversation transcript and slot snapshot to a CRM endpoint — either as a handoff channel or automatically when a slot is written. Create one to get started.
webhook.detailsDesc: Name, description and the endpoint the transcript is POSTed to.
webhook.name: Name
webhook.nameDesc: Unique identifier — letters, digits, underscore, hyphen, dot. Used as the handoff destination.
webhook.descriptionPlaceholder: What does this webhook send and where?
webhook.targetUrlDesc: Absolute http(s) endpoint. CRM webhook receiver, Zapier/Make catch hook, or your own listener.
webhook.targetUrlRequired: An absolute http(s) target URL is required.
webhook.payloadDesc: Shape the request body to the CRM's schema and add custom headers. GET/DELETE send no body.
webhook.payloadTemplateDesc: JSON body with {{slot}} placeholders interpolated from the conversation slots (JSON-escaped). Leave blank to send the default envelope (event / conversationId / slot / transcript / slots).
webhook.headersJsonDesc: JSON object of extra request headers. A custom Authorization here overrides the one below.
webhook.triggerDesc: Decide whether this webhook fires automatically on slot writes or only on explicit handoff.
webhook.slotTriggerDesc: A slot name (e.g. email) fires the webhook when that slot changes; * fires on any slot write; leave blank to make it handoff-only.
webhook.includeSlotsDesc: Comma-separated whitelist of slots to send in the payload. Blank = send every captured slot.
webhook.securityDesc: Optional Authorization header attached to every POST. Stored encrypted at rest.
webhook.authHeaderDesc: Full header value sent as Authorization (e.g. 'Bearer xyz' or 'Basic …'). Leave blank for none.
webhook.authHeaderConfigured: A credential is stored. Leave blank to keep it, or type a new value to rotate it.
webhook.enabledDesc: Disabled webhooks never fire — neither on slot writes nor on handoff.
webhook.saveFailed: Could not save webhook. Check the form for validation errors.
webhook.createDescription: Author a new outbound webhook that fires on handoff or slot writes.
webhook.editDescription: Edit a webhook — changes apply across every chat flow.
